points.text: The team outlined the project brief: designing a new remote control in three stages, targeting a €25 selling price, ≤ €12.50 production cost, and €50 million revenue.
Uncertainties were raised about the production cost figure ($1,250) and whether the €25 price is wholesale or retail, indicating these details need clarification.
Potential international design challenges such as regional zones, frequency standards, and varied keypad symbols were identified and will require further investigation.
The team agreed that the remote control should primarily aim to combine control of multiple devices such as TV, satellite, VCR, and others.
Production cost was identified as the main factor limiting how many features can be included in the remote control.
The next phase is the functional design stage, with each discipline assigned to work on its area and to receive instructions by email.
Laura said she has to do a design project next semester, which she sees as good training.
They listed possible courses for the next semester, including USDP, lighting, computer design, operating systems, ADS, computer security, and computer architecture.
They decided not to take databases and privacy courses.
